context_in: Die 19 martii S. Ioseph (st-joseph, SOLEMNITY) > after AD I ET II VESPERAS hymn (ended p356). p357 opens with AD INVITATORIUM.

rows.incipit: Laudemus Deum nostrum in sollemnitate beati Ioseph

flags: Iste quem laeti runs over to p358 (stanzas 3-5, Amen); Lauds hymn Caelitum, Ioseph, decus begins on p358 and is assigned there. Paschal invitatory alternative is printed only as a cue to p370 (index lists All., Chr. Dnum qui putari on p370).
